transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Voice interaction with AI chatbots proved easier and more natural than typing, according to a confirmed report from XDA.
One month after China's new regulations took effect, reported by 东方财富, many platforms still make human customer service hard to reach despite requirements for clear access.
OpenAI released 722 papers on 300 math problems, sparking backlash over academic integrity, reported by The Korea Daily.
Claude artificial intelligence speculates Ethereum could hit 25K to 40K by 2027 under institutional adoption, still open per 99Bitcoins.
Anthropic's Claude submitted a false tip on a Philadelphia unsolved homicide case, reported by Associated Press.
